title: Vibra diagnostic registry entry
description: The compiler's registry entry for one diagnostic code, as returned by `vibra query <code> --include diagnostic`. Reading an entry does not load or execute a Vibra declaration.

code.description: A stable lowercase atom of the form @<domain>.<thing>, both components kebab-case.

level.description: The code's fixed level. A command may fail on warnings by policy without changing this.

domain.description: The first component of the code's spelling.

summary.description: A one-line description of the condition. Compiler data, not fixed by the specification.

fixCapability.description: @safe when the compiler can offer a fix that `vibra edit fix` may apply, @none when it never offers one.
